cover.headline:
One place to run
the whole studio.
cover.lede: A phased plan to move Acme's sales, projects and team into one Notion operating system, before the next hires arrive. Based on our conversation on November 10.

glance.p: A system the next two hires can learn in a week.
Four phases in about five weeks.
Bank transfer, or card with a 4% fee.

context.title:
What we
heard.
context.lede: Acme is a 9-person design studio with steady demand. The problem isn't clients, it's the process behind them: work lives in email, WhatsApp and a spreadsheet only Jane understands.

pains.p: Follow-ups depend on memory, and there's no view of what's about to close.
Nobody can see how many rounds each project has used until it's too late.
Access is all or nothing, so freelancers either miss context or see client finances.

quote.text: I don't want to hire into chaos again. I want the system first.

context.opportunity: Demand is proven and the services are defined. Building the operating system now means the Q1 hires join a studio that's ready to scale, instead of adding to the noise.

focus.title:
Where we'd
start.
focus.statement: You asked for a lot, and all of it makes sense. Our recommendation is to start with sales and projects, because that's where the hires will work from day one.
recommend: Notion AI where it saves real time
Finance later, once the data exists
focus.why: Finance depends on clean project and sales data, so building it first would mean building it twice.

proposal.title:
Four phases,
one price.
proposal.intro: Each phase has its own price and they add up to one fixed total. The tags show what the project needs, what we advise, and what could wait.

phases.name: Discovery and architecture
phases.summary: We map how the studio works today and design the system before building it.

phases.name: Build and training
phases.summary: The operating system, built with weekly co-creation sessions.
deliverables: Personal hubs for each team member

phases.name: Notion AI setup
phases.summary: Agents and prompts for briefs, meeting notes and client updates.

phases.name: Data migration
phases.summary: We move active clients and projects from the spreadsheet into Notion.

included: Client portal with timeline and deliverables
proposal.guarantee: One month after delivery to fix issues within the delivered scope, at no extra cost.

payment.schedule: 50% when you accept, 50% on delivery. By bank transfer, or by card through Stripe with a 4% card fee.

next_steps.p: We send you the link to book the kickoff.

closing:
We're ready to build
your Eureka moment.
